📥 Download Settings

Configure how games are downloaded and installed.

Runs the repack's setup.exe silently into the install folder, then deletes the leftover setup/.bin files and adds the finished game automatically. The install step is CPU-heavy and may show one Windows permission prompt to approve.

Tells the repack installer to deselect its optional tasks, so it won't re-run the DirectX/Visual C++ installers or open the FitGirl website after installing. Turn this off if a game fails to launch because it needs a runtime you don't have. (Some repacks force a runtime regardless — that's controlled by the repack, not the launcher.)

Shows interactive hosts such as BuzzHeavier and routes restricted-host buttons to Sail's built-in browser so you can complete their verification or final download step yourself.

Sail takes over files started from the browser, shows their progress and speed in Downloads, then extracts archives and prepares them like any other game download.

Connect a debrid account to unlock premium filehosts (GoFile, 1Fichier, Rapidgator…) and the SteamRIP source. When connected, downloads automatically resolve through the service. Paste an API key and it validates instantly.

One Cloudflare Worker URL per line. PixelDrain downloads are routed through a random worker to bypass the 10 GB/day per-IP limit (it falls back to another worker, then to a direct download, automatically). Leave empty to download directly. A ready-to-deploy worker ships in cloudflare-worker/pixeldrain-proxy.js — deploy it free on Cloudflare and paste the URL here.

Remembers a resolved direct link for 24h so re-downloading the same game is instant. Turn off to always re-resolve.

Clears cached resolved download links and the in-app browser's stored cache so stale or expired links are fetched fresh. Your settings, library and downloaded games are not touched.

Use Custom Client Keys

ℹ️ OAuth Callback URI to register:
http://localhost:53232/callback
📖 Setup Instructions
Google Drive Setup Guide
  1. Go to the Google Cloud Console.
  2. Create a project, search for Google Drive API, and click Enable.
  3. Go to OAuth consent screen, select External, and configure it. Add the scope: .../auth/drive.file.
  4. Under Credentials, click + Create Credentials -> OAuth client ID.
  5. Select Application type: Web application.
  6. Under Authorized redirect URIs, add: http://localhost:53232/callback.
  7. Copy the generated Client ID and paste it below.
  8. ⚠️ If you get "Access Blocked / Error 403: access_denied": Go back to the OAuth consent screen page in Google Console, and under Test users, click + Add Users and enter your Google email address. Alternatively, click Publish App under Publishing status to set the app to Production.
Microsoft OneDrive Setup Guide
  1. Go to the Azure Portal (under App registrations).
  2. Click New registration. Set Supported account types to Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts.
  3. Under Redirect URI, select Web and enter: http://localhost:53232/callback.
  4. Click Register, copy the Application (client) ID from the Overview page, and paste it below.
Dropbox Setup Guide
  1. Go to the Dropbox App Console.
  2. Click Create app. Select Scoped access and Full Dropbox access.
  3. Under the Settings tab, set OAuth 2 Redirect URIs to: http://localhost:53232/callback.
  4. Under the Permissions tab, enable: files.content.write, files.content.read, and files.metadata.read, then click Submit.
  5. Copy the App key (Client ID) and App secret (Client Secret) and paste them below.

Feature Testing

Trigger launcher features on demand to verify they work. These run for real — windows open, live data is fetched, and the downloader actually downloads a small sample file.

Reinstall latest release

Fetches the latest release for the selected channel and runs the real installer, even when that version is already installed.

"Update complete" window

Opens the real post-update window for the current version, including the View Changelog button.

Alert banner (live)

Re-fetches the live alert from Supabase and renders the in-app banner exactly as users see it.

💜 Supporters window

Opens the Supporters window and pulls the live list from the Sail Hub supporters page.

Plugin update check

Runs the real plugin update check and refreshes the sidebar Plugins update badge.

Downloader (real sample)

Starts a genuine download job through the full pipeline using a small real .zip, so the dock, progress and extraction all run for real.
